 November Social Security direct payment worth $994 goes out in five days
 By Adisa Hargett-Robinson 
 Published
 October 25, 2026 9:00am ET
 Advertisement -->
 Advertisement 
 Add Washington Examiner on Google
 Advertisement 
 The November 2026 Supplemental Security Income payments, worth up to $994, will be sent to recipients in five days.
 SSI payments are typically issued on the first day of each month, or on the last business day of the prior month if the first day falls on a federal holiday. Nov. 1 is a Sunday, so recipients will receive their benefits on Oct. 30.

 The program supports people with limited income who are blind, age 65 or older, or have a qualifying disability.
 Advertisement 
 The amount beneficiaries receive varies based on several factors, including the number of people filing . For example, individual filers can receive up to $994, couples filing jointly can receive $1,491, and those providing essential care to SSI recipients can receive up to $498.
 In addition to the previous prerequisites for receiving SSI payments , recipients must also be U.S. citizens or noncitizens in one of the alien classifications granted by the Department of Homeland Security.
 LIST: WHERE ALL THE CANDIDATES IN COMPETITIVE SENATE RACES STAND ON DATA CENTERS 
 Advertisement Additionally, recipients must live in one of the 50 states, the District of Columbia, or the Northern Mariana Islands, and must not be absent from the United States for a full calendar month or 30 consecutive days.
 A full calendar for the Social Security Administration payments can be viewed on the agency’s website.
